title: Lead Platform Engineer
description:
About the role
We are hiring a Lead Platform Engineer for our Platform team (Austin, TX (on-site)).

What you will do
- Manage infrastructure as code
- Automate builds, tests and deployments
- Run and improve our cloud infrastructure
- Set up monitoring, alerting and incident response

What you bring
- At least 9 years of relevant experience
- Solid working knowledge of Networking, Bash, Docker and Ansible

Nice to have
- Jenkins, Terraform, Helm and Python
